description: Expander for enver mini and ad mini, adding one more signal path through their envelope; it goes immediately to the right of the module it expands, or to the right of another expander

inputs.text: A signal to be shaped by the envelope of the module to the left

outputs.text: That signal at the level of the envelope, scaled by the LVL knob on the module that drives it

notes: this module has no controls of its own; the attack, decay, level and mode all come from the enver mini or ad mini it is attached to.
menu: Add Expander — places another eX expander to the right of this one, chained to the same envelope
